thesis: Selected buyback advice begins with a time audit and contextual questions before reallocating work.
summary: The reviewed passages propose comparing a calendar with quarterly goals and asking an AI assistant to clarify context before recommending changes. The purpose is to redirect time toward work that matters. Claimed hours saved are not verified, and calendar access or automation does not itself justify changing commitments or sending messages.
